result.summary: The page is largely well-structured with no obvious rendering breaks, overlaps, or misaligned elements. The main concerns are a filter state that doesn't match the content shown and some low-contrast secondary text. Edge-clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded as intended.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is selected, but the 'Popular right now' section leads with Tokumaru Ramen Bar and shows no pizza-specific results above it. The filter state and the displayed content appear inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Confirm the active filter is applied to all sections, or update the chip selection to reflect the content shown. Ensure the 'Popular right now' list refreshes when a category is selected.

issues.description: Secondary gray text, such as the delivery fees under the 'Fastest near you' cards, the '(500+)' review count, the '25–35 min' and '€0 delivery' metadata, and the search placeholder, appears light gray on white and may fall below recommended contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken these secondary text colors to meet WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1 for normal text).
